revisionDesc.change: Finalized - This is good to go.
Vote - AcceptText - Fine. ("(from the photo)": article not needed).

Vote - AcceptText - I agree with the reading and the rationale. Looking at the images, I would also indent r.30 and r.31, would replace .4.4 in v.32 with .8, and would encode the final line on the verso Ζήν[ω]νι as lying in the right margin. The edition implies that this margin note lies on line 32, but the image indicates otherwise (l. 35 would be more accurate).

Submit - In line 23 I think ε is a preferable reading over ϛ in paleographical terms (just compare to ε in the next line). The number ε is also in the subscription (l.34 on the verso side), when referring to these same articles. Corrections is proposed as <:<#ε=5#=PN A. de Frutos García (from the photo) |ed|<#ϛ=6#>:>

Commit - In line 23 I think ε is a preferable reading over ϛ in paleographical terms (just compare to ε in the next line). The number ε is also in the subscription (l.34 on the verso side), when referring to these same articles. I'm proposing this correction: <:<#ε=5#=PN A. de Frutos García (from the photo) |ed|<#ϛ=6#>:>
